versions.changelog:
Initial public release with foundational documentation and evaluation setup.

- Added core documentation outlining tiered quantity discount strategy for DTC skincare and beauty stores.
- Included reference materials for margin calculations and tier structuring.
- Introduced initial evals and scripts directories with placeholders and README files.
- Clarified use cases, triggers, required outputs, and actionable examples.
- Provided guidance on margin safety, copywriting, and performance measurement for multi-buy offers.

Initial release — introduces structured, margin-safe tiered quantity discount playbooks for DTC skincare/beauty stores.

- Turns “buy more, save more” goals into clear, actionable tiered discount strategies focused on serums, moisturizers, cleansers, and similar products.
- Outputs: tier table (quantity → % off), margin validation, copy examples for PDP/cart, and a data-driven measurement plan.
- Ensures margin floors are protected and discount tiers are simple/easy to communicate.
- Works even if users don’t mention “quantity breaks” explicitly; triggers on any AOV/bundle/multi-buy context within skincare/beauty.
- Adapts to Shopify, WooCommerce, or other storefronts; offers manual/app implementation guidance.
